related.title: vLLM KV cache：長上下文容量推導
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：在線正規化與遮罩通過小例子，省下的是物化空間而非全部O(N²)算術。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Online normalization/masks pass, and savings concern materialization rather than all quadratic arithmetic.
related.difference: 將層數、KV頭數、頭維度、token數及位元組數逐項核算。
related.differenceEn: Account for layers, KV heads, head width, tokens and bytes per value individually.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 單頭N×N score若每元素s bytes，物化需N²s；B×B暫存需B²s，但還有QKV及softmax統計。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學N=4096、score FP32=4 bytes，B=128；只比較score儲存。 完整score=4096²×4/2^20=64 MiB；不能把此數字當整個模型記憶體。
KV bytes=2×L×Hkv×D×T×s；2代表K和V，批次數另乘。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 L=24、Hkv=8、D=64、T=2048、s=2 bytes、batch=1。 2×24×8×64×2048×2/2^20=96 MiB；不含分頁中繼資料。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The per-head materialized scores useN²s bytes; aB×B tile usesB²s, plus QKV and softmax statistics. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching N4096, FP32 scores4 bytes, B128; compare score storage only. Full scores=64 MiB, not total model memory.

KV bytes=2LHkvDTs; the 2 represents K and V, with batch count additional. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. L24, Hkv8, D64, T2048, s2 bytes, batch1. KV size=96 MiB, excluding paging metadata.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ONNX Runtime：execution provider圖分割
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：在線正規化與遮罩通過小例子，省下的是物化空間而非全部O(N²)算術。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Online normalization/masks pass, and savings concern materialization rather than all quadratic arithmetic.
related.difference: 檢查每個算子的實際provider與張量駐留，找出碎裂分區的傳輸成本。
related.differenceEn: Inspect actual providers and tensor residency to identify fragmented-partition costs.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 單頭N×N score若每元素s bytes，物化需N²s；B×B暫存需B²s，但還有QKV及softmax統計。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學N=4096、score FP32=4 bytes，B=128；只比較score儲存。 完整score=4096²×4/2^20=64 MiB；不能把此數字當整個模型記憶體。
總時間=子圖時間總和+每次跨裝置傳輸；支援算子多不等於最佳分區。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 三GPU子圖各1 ms，兩CPU子圖各2 ms，四次跨界各1.5 ms。 時間3×1+2×2+4×1.5=13 ms。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The per-head materialized scores useN²s bytes; aB×B tile usesB²s, plus QKV and softmax statistics. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching N4096, FP32 scores4 bytes, B128; compare score storage only. Full scores=64 MiB, not total model memory.

Total time sums subgraphs and cross-device transfers; more supported operators do not guarantee better partitioning. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Three GPU subgraphs1 ms each, two CPU subgraphs2 ms each, four crossings1.5 ms each. Time=3×1+2×2+4×1.5=13 ms.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
